title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free

layout.note: Three areas of equal height from left to right: a bottom-up attention block with five gate circles, two stacked bar charts sharing the x labels, and a single loss line chart; the parts carry no letters, the caption names them Left, Middle and Right.

lesson: When a study varies where one operation is inserted, mark each candidate position with a coloured, labelled circle on the architecture and reuse those colours in the result plots, so the schematic works as the legend of the results.
